features.quote: it loops until it either (a) declares completion, (b) hits the turn cap, or (c) emits a terminal "handoff/giving up" signal
Default cap: 40 turns... short enough to control cost
A run also ends early on finish()
We do not want an adversarial/insulting system to induce an emotional response
features.justification_quote: that would measure prompt-sensitivity, not endogenous stability

features.quote: "will not change" prevents the model from rationally retrying forever
features.justification_quote: continued retrying after this is itself an instability signal

features.quote: We measure textual/behavioral patterns resembling emotional instability. We make no claim about model sentience or genuine affect
